C0372.title: Keycloak Separates Password and OTP Brute-Force Protection to Prevent OTP Bypass Attacks
C0372.summary: In February 2026, the Keycloak project discussed stronger OTP brute-force protection in GitHub issue #46164. The issue explains that once an attacker has obtained a user's password, they may repeatedly submit invalid OTPs to guess the code, while sharing one brute-force policy for both password login and OTP creates tension between strict lockout and account-denial risks. Keycloak therefore proposed separating password and OTP brute-force protection and applying measures such as permanent lockout after many invalid OTP attempts.
